# Tree component source reference

Verify the frozen reference with `node scripts/tree-widget-reference.mjs --frozen`.

The snapshot includes complete Nivo 0.99.0 Tree source files, package metadata and its full MIT license. The verifier checks source, license, producer and pinned TSX compiler hashes and re-executes the original UID/computed-data hooks, node/link creation and transition recipes, default JSX, event-handler recipes, Canvas rendering functions and layer dispatch expressions.

Hierarchy traversal objects, numeric coordinates, scales, colors, React hooks, JSX, Spring scalars and path generators are explicit synchronous probes. This reference does not execute React or Spring scheduling, D3 tree numeric layout, native Canvas assignment validation, browser input or framebuffer rendering. Original nested `node.data` references and signed zero are checked before serialization. Rust uses flat, globally unique IDs; its radial orientation and aggregate scalar are separate contracts.

Node leave sets size to zero; link leave retains its thickness. Zero-size nodes, zero-thickness links and noninteractive records still create components when their layer exists. Original dot-joined path UIDs can collide and the fixture preserves that behavior. Label source is included to document the separate label component role, which this node/link feature does not implement.
